label: Energy utility
description: An electric utility: substations, feeders, a control center with SCADA/EMS, field crews, customers and regulators. Plans: the NERC CIP-008 cyber incident response plan (E-ISAC and CISA within 1 hour of a reportable incident), EOP-004 event reporting, DOE OE-417 (1-hour emergency alert), restoration and backup control center plans.

vocabulary.facility: the service territory, substations and control center
vocabulary.frontline: system operators, line crews, substation technicians, meter readers, call-center agents

ot: telecom (microwave, fiber, private LTE) and GPS time

roles.name: Manager of System Operations (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Owns the grid, the switching orders and the operators.

roles.name: OT / IT Security Manager (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns SCADA, the corporate network and the investigation.

roles.name: Corporate Communications Manager (PIO)
roles.description: Owns customer messaging, social media and the press.

roles.name: Director of Corporate Security
roles.description: Owns physical security and the law-enforcement liaison.

roles.name: Field Operations Supervisor
roles.description: Owns the crews, the trucks and what is actually happening at the pole.

roles.name: CIP Senior Manager (Compliance)
roles.description: Owns the CIP-008 reporting determination and NERC / DOE filings.

roles.name: Customer Operations Director
roles.description: Owns ETRs, the outage map, medical-baseline customers and IVR messages.

outsideParties: large customers (a hospital, a water plant)
the Reliability Coordinator and Balancing Authority
mediaChannels: customer posts on X/Twitter and the outage map

sceneAnchors.public: a residential street with utility poles and a bucket truck, a line crew in hard hats, neighbors watching from a porch, daylight
sceneAnchors.control: inside an electric utility control center: a wide console with operators wearing headsets, a large dark mimic-board wall, low lighting
sceneAnchors.exterior: inside a fenced high-voltage substation: transformers, busbars and insulators, a gravel yard, a small control house, overcast sky
